_comment: Real projects copied into an eval sandbox with `git archive`. repo is relative to $KOIN_EVAL_PROJECTS (default ~/workspace). catalog: the repo's shared version catalog, copied in so the project stands alone.

android-dsl.about: Android Views, Koin 4.2 + Compiler Plugin, DSL (mixed classic and Safe DSL)

android-annotations.about: Android Views, Koin 4.2 + Compiler Plugin, Annotations, @KoinApplication

android-annotations-ksp.about: Android, Koin 4.1.1 + koin-annotations 2.3.2 with KSP, Kotlin 2.2.21

android-dsl-no-plugin.about: Android, Koin 4.1.1 autowire DSL (singleOf/viewModelOf), CheckModulesTest, no Compiler Plugin

hilt-nowinandroid.about: Now in Android: multi-module Hilt app with build-logic convention plugins

metro-kotlinconf.about: KotlinConf app: KMP client on Metro, Ktor backend on Koin 4.1.1

android-compose-dsl.about: Android Jetpack Compose, Koin 4.2 + Compiler Plugin, DSL

jetnews-manual-di.about: JetNews (Compose): dependencies wired by hand through an AppContainer, no DI framework

compose-reply.about: Reply (Compose, adaptive email app): no DI, one ViewModel, no Application class

compose-jetsnack.about: Jetsnack (Compose shop): no DI, no Application class

compose-jetsurvey.about: Jetsurvey (Compose survey): no DI, four ViewModels with hand-written factories

compose-crane.about: Crane (Compose travel): Hilt, three ViewModels, a :benchmark module

android-skills.about: Google's official Android skills plugin, loaded next to ours
